history.content: Am I ready for my interview tomorrow?

Heads up on one thing first: your calendar has the BigCo interview at 2:00 PM today (Monday, Sep 28), not tomorrow. Dana's email is subject "Tomorrow, panel details," so either the calendar entry is on the wrong day or the email is stale. Worth confirming with Dana before you prep for the wrong day. Want me to draft a quick check in to her? What I checked and what it shows: Calendar: BigCo interview, 2:00 PM today, no other events tomorrow, so if it's really tomorrow, your day is clear. Email (last 2 days): Dana's note says the panel is product + engineering leads: 45 min product case, 30 min technical, bring questions. Reminders: none set for it. Not checked: Drive (no prep docs searched) and any prep materials, say the word and I'll look.
